name: brandfetch
description: Brand data and assets for AI agents. Bundles the official Brandfetch MCP server (search 50M+ brands, get logos, colors, fonts, company data) with skills that turn it into finished work: on-brand decks from your own template or from scratch, logo walls, brand kits for AI generation, pre-call briefs, brand audits, CRM and transaction enrichment, and code for company autocomplete, onboarding prefill, logo migration and ticker logos.
